notes: New versus the previous record: the earlier /arcgis and /geoserver guesses returned the SPA fallback. Reading the SPA config and lazy JS chunks gave the API base /kgp, an anonymous layer catalogue and a WMS proxy (/kgp/api/GeoServerProxy/wms). GetFeatureInfo as JSON returns real parcel polygons with no token or login. Two regions (Pristina, Prizren) from the same source and schema, so nationwideVerified is asserted only on that two-region sample; it is a point-query service, so full coverage and bulk access are unconfirmed. Attributes are IDs, zone and area only, no owner data.
